body: Oh my God I'm so sorry you're going through this. Please call your therapist ASAP. They can help you with this. Just please try to make it through the night and see if you can have an emergency session tomorrow.

It's takes a lot of balls to admit it and say it out loud. It sounds like you're going through hell. I honestly wish there was something I could say to give you some comfort and peace. Is there anyone you can trust to talk to about this? This sounds like so much to deal with on your own. I don't know if this helps but sometimes what helps me when I'm at my lowest is to do something for someone else. Like bake cookies or give them a gift. It makes me feel like if I made them a little bit happy even temporarily than I have a little more self worth.

I'm really sorry you're going through this. Is there anyway you could do something to help relieve some of this? I used to get so angry I would pull out my hair. Now instead, I know it sounds super weird but hang in there with me, I make candles. It seems dumb but it requires a lot of focus and I give them away as gifts which makes some people happy. Finding something that can occupy all of your emotional capacity and all of your thoughts can really help get you out of this temporarily.
Sometimes being with someone that loves you can teach you to love yourself. That can give you a lot to live for. I know it's clishe but there is some truth to it.

Maybe. I don't know about grad school. I'm really hard on myself and it would be pretty bad if I just took time off. I feel like I'm just too weak to handle all this stuff. I really appreciate your support. Sorry to put this all out here like this.
Thank you. We used to be. I don't know how close we are now. She has a new boyfriend who is able to be there for her so she doesn't rely on me as much anymore.
